hero.eyebrow: Vilanova i la Geltrú · Passeig del Carme
hero.title: Sea cooking, wood fire and Mediterranean memory
hero.subtitle: A neighbourhood restaurant on the promenade, where the fish arrives fresh and the fire does the rest. Rice dishes, tapas and plates made for sharing.
hero.point1: Wood-fire cooking and fresh fish from the market
hero.point2: Outdoor terrace on the seafront promenade

about.title: A seafaring classic in Vilanova
about.lead: La Gambarrada is a Mediterranean eating house on the Passeig del Carme, a couple of steps from the port. Seasonal produce, a wood fire and a menu that looks out to sea.
about.body1: The kitchen starts from whatever the fish market brings in: wood-fired mussels with rosemary, baby squid, seafood rice and rock fish. The hand over the fire and the exact point of the broth are the house signature.
about.body2: The dining room is bright and unhurried, with tables outside for sunny days. It works as well for a long family lunch as for dinner with friends.

features.title: What you need to know before you come

dineIn.title: Dine in
dineIn.text: Table service indoors and on the promenade terrace.

reserve.title: Reservations recommended
reserve.text: The restaurant takes bookings, especially at weekends and for groups.

outdoor.title: Outdoor terrace
outdoor.text: Tables in the open air facing the sea, in the shade.

groups.title: Good for groups
groups.text: Large tables and sharing plates at the centre of the menu.

kids.title: Family friendly
kids.text: A calm room that works for lunch with children too.

dessert.title: Dessert and coffee
dessert.text: House desserts to close the meal, plus proper coffee.

payment.title: Card payments
payment.text: Credit and debit cards, contactless payment and cash.

parking.title: Parking nearby
parking.text: Paid car park on the promenade and metered street parking.

menu.title: What comes off the fire
menu.lead: The menu changes with the season and with whatever enters the fish market. These are the plates the house is best known for.

mussels.title: Wood-fired mussels with rosemary
mussels.text: Over a wood fire with rosemary, and good bread to mop up.

croquettes.title: House croquettes
croquettes.text: Creamy inside, crisp outside. They never last long.

squid.title: Baby squid and squid
squid.text: Fresh, cooked just so, barely marked by the fire.

rice.title: Seafood rice dishes
rice.text: Paella and soupy rice with produce from the fish market.

tapas.title: Tapas and small plates
tapas.text: The easiest way to try half the menu without deciding.

carpaccio.title: Prawn carpaccio
carpaccio.text: Cold, thin and dressed with good oil. A house classic.

menu.note: No prices or opening hours on this page: confirm availability and a table by phone.

reviews.title: What guests say after visiting
reviews.lead: Extracts from reviews published on Google by guests of the restaurant.

r1.text: Extremely good food: wood-fired mussels with rosemary, amazing croquettes and squid that was so tender. Excellent quality and brilliant service. A lovely spot right on the seafront.
r1.author: The Famous Gold Watch

r2.text: A wonderful seafood restaurant with fresh, high-quality dishes. The paella with prawn carpaccio was delicious and the squid was incredibly fresh.
r2.author: amp onpawee

r3.text: An absolute must-visit in Vilanova. Warm and welcoming yet stylish and relaxed, perfect for a long lunch or dinner with friends and family. The food is outstanding and the service top-notch.
r3.author: Earoel Kennedy

r4.text: Delicious food, friendly staff, a nice place: you can sit inside or outside. Better to book ahead.
r4.author: Ivan
